game.q: no woman had ever been ordained. she asks to be the first. what happens?
opts: a yes on the very first ask
she’s told no, asks again, and wins
she takes the hint and goes home

wrong.easy: nope. it took more than one ask.
wrong.hint: she walked there on swollen feet. she did not take the hint.

game.right: YES. she cut her hair, walked with other women, and asked again. with ananda’s help, the first nun.

end.line: his mother died. her sister raised him, then became the first buddhist nun.
end.l1: his mom was gone. her sister stepped in.
end.l2: then she became the first nun.

cliff.s1: eight wise men read a baby’s future.
cliff.s2: seven raise two fingers. the youngest raises one.

share: his mom was gone in seven days. her sister stepped in. the story on infinite hill
